name: Neumorphism / Soft UI
description: 배경과 같은 표면에 빛과 그림자를 짝지어 돌출·함몰을 만드는 부드러운 스타일입니다.

source.title: ui-neumorphism
source.note: 50+ React neumorphic components; strong canonical implementation reference.

canonicalAcceptance: Raised and inset surfaces must be visibly driven by paired shadow geometry on a near-background surface; not just a gray card with one drop shadow.

name: Skeuomorphism
description: 나무·금속·유리의 질감과 실제 눌리는 컨트롤로 물리적 도구를 닮은 화면입니다.

source.title: Tactile UI
source.note: 30+ tactile/skeuomorphic React components. README says learning/testing only; treat as reference/adaptation with explicit provenance, not production endorsement.

canonicalAcceptance: Use physical material cues (gloss, bevel, inset, texture/lighting) and at least one tactile control state.

name: Bauhaus
description: 원·사각형·삼각형과 원색, 비대칭 그리드로 기능과 조형을 연결합니다.

source.title: design-isms
source.note: Taxonomy benchmark only; no code/text/image copying.

canonicalAcceptance: Primary geometry, asymmetric/function-led grid, strong display type and restrained primary-color accents; avoid turning it into generic geometric minimalism.

name: Japandi
description: 따뜻한 자연색, 절제된 글꼴과 넉넉한 여백으로 조용한 재료감을 만듭니다.
canonicalAcceptance: Warm natural neutrals, restrained serif/sans pairing, natural-material impression and generous rhythm; avoid generic beige SaaS.

name: Bottom Sheet
description: 화면 아래에서 펼쳐지고 터치 드래그로 높이를 조절하는 모달 패널입니다.

source.title: pure-web-bottom-sheet
source.note: Accessible, scroll-snap based, framework-agnostic, React wrapper, multiple snap points.

canonicalAcceptance: Touch drag/snap heights + modal semantics; simple bottom-aligned dialog is insufficient.

name: Command Palette
description: 검색과 키보드만으로 그룹별 명령을 찾아 실행하는 빠른 작업 창입니다.

source.title: beUI Command Palette
source.note: Repository explicitly lists a ⌘K palette with fuzzy filter and animated active row.

canonicalAcceptance: Keyboard-first searchable action surface with groups, shortcuts and active-row behavior.

name: Toast Notification
description: 작업을 막지 않고 결과를 알리며 쌓이거나 자동으로 닫히는 알림입니다.
canonicalAcceptance: Non-blocking live-region notification with lifecycle/stacking/dismiss behavior.

name: Skeleton Loading
description: 실제 콘텐츠와 같은 자리를 먼저 확보해 로딩 중에도 화면 구조를 유지합니다.
canonicalAcceptance: Placeholders preserve target layout and communicate loading; spinner-only is insufficient.

name: Segmented Control
description: 한 그룹에서 하나의 옵션을 선택하고 표시 데이터까지 함께 바꾸는 컨트롤입니다.

source.title: @rc-component/segmented
source.note: Canonical accessible segmented control with keyboard/RTL/vertical support.

canonicalAcceptance: Mutually exclusive compact options with a clear active indicator and keyboard behavior.

name: Agency Landing
description: 프로젝트 사례와 큰 타이포그래피를 중심으로 작업 방식과 문의까지 연결하는 에이전시 페이지입니다.

source.title: Agency Website v2
source.note: Use only as visual/fidelity benchmark: GSAP, Motion, Lenis, WebGL smoke cursor.

canonicalAcceptance: Case-study-led creative composition with strong motion language and project storytelling.
